UPDATE orchestration_pod
         SET server = $2, name = $3, comment = $4, port = $5, bind_ip = $6, advertise_ip = $7,
             ingress = $8, receive_proxy_protocol = $9, tls_sni = $10, tls_dns_provider = $11,
             tls_domain_id = $12, tls_acme_directory = $13, route = $14
         WHERE id = $1
